# Department of Consent

> Beginner-focused kink coaching by Jules. Practical education, one-to-one coaching, and nonsexual event support for adults (18+) moving from curiosity to informed, confident real-world exploration. Virtual coaching, with selected in-person services in San Francisco and the greater Bay Area.

## Notes

- Coaching is educational and practical — not therapy, medical care, legal advice, or crisis support.
- Event accompaniment is nonsexual. Services never include kink play, dating, or physical intimacy.
- All services are for adults aged 18 and older.
